blocks.raw: <ExamTip>The PEC follows the National Electrical Code (NEC) structure but with Philippine amendments. When a question specifies Philippine practice, always apply PEC, not NEC. The voltage levels differ: the US standard is 120/240V; the Philippine standard is 230/400V.</ExamTip>

blocks.raw: <Warn>RA 9514 is one of the most heavily tested Philippine laws across the entire LEA. It appears in both LEA-UTIL and in Laws and Professional Practice. Know the fire safety clearance process, the occupancy-based sprinkler requirements, the means of egress requirements, and the fire rating requirements for different elements of construction.</Warn>
